required_concepts: 2D shape that can be represented in 3 dimensions
optional_concepts: can be oriented with different perspectives, shapes, and forms
acceptable_paraphrases: shape with two sides that have the same length and are parallel to each other
figure with opposite sides of equal length and parallel
a shape where opposite sides are parallel
a quadrilateral with pairs of parallel sides
critical_errors: confusing it with a rectangle or square
assuming it must be oriented in a specific direction
misconceptions: thinking only squares and rectangles are parallelograms
believing a shape needs to have right angles to be a parallelogram
assuming all shapes with parallel sides are triangles
grading_notes: Acceptable answers may vary in capitalization or spelling, but must clearly identify the correct concept.
